name: Battle Gift Set: Thundurus vs Tornadus

releases.name: Battle Gift Set: Thundurus vs Tornadus

description.text: Battle Gift Set: Thundurus VS Tornadus, released on 18 November 2011 for the winter holidays: two ready-built 30-card half decks led by the Legendary Pokémon Thundurus and Tornadus, each with Energy of three types, meant for newcomers and experienced players alike. It also held a Super Rare holo Landorus, special holo cards of Reshiram, Zekrom and Victini with original artwork, strong Trainer cards, a playmat, a coin, damage counters and markers, a rule book, a deck case and a damage counter case.
